name: 军用科技 / 重型工业
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one finished, highly polished horizontal brand lockup for AWCS, a software system for AI-agent-assisted coordination of warehouse robots. Wide composition approximately 3:1 on PURE WHITE. Main text exactly AWCS. Chinese subtitle exactly 智能仓储协同调度系统. Smaller English line exactly Agent-Assisted Warehouse Coordination System. Preserve the names perfectly; the Chinese title contains ten characters. Beautiful optical kerning, clear hierarchy, crisp vector-like artwork, generous margins. No mockup scene, photography, house/roof clipart, literal robot face, generic brain, unnecessary tagline, watermark, extra labels or logos. This is a stylistic study for AWCS, not a partnership announcement. Only AWCS and its two approved names may appear; do not write the reference company's name. Do not reproduce the reference company's actual logo. Design an original AWCS symbol using the requested visual language. Reference direction: Militech from Cyberpunk 2077, pragmatic new militarism, procurement-grade engineered identity and equipment stencils. Pure white background, charcoal-black, deep olive-gray, one sparse safety-yellow intervention. A powerful original compact emblem of staggered parallel track plates locking into a routing channel, not a weapon and not the actual Militech emblem. At right AWCS as a highly legible broad, mechanically cut industrial wordmark, tightly engineered uppercase, selective stencil breaks, squared shoulders and chamfered corners. It should look like it belongs on rugged warehouse robotics equipment rather than a racing team. Chinese subtitle strong and functional, exact full English name smaller with technical humanist or monospaced styling. No firearms, bullets, soldiers, American flag, actual Militech text, fake military serial numbers or unsupported claims. Strict optical alignment, clean flat graphics, no dirt, grunge, glows, gradients or 3D. This must be visually heavier and more utilitarian than the refined red Arasaka-inspired direction.
